title.narrative: Bangladesh Agroecology Platform - Promotion of Agroecology Principles Group

description.narrative:
The Promotion of Agroecology Principles Group is one of 3 subgroups of the Bangladesh Agroecology Platform (BAP). BAP was formed to bring together likeminded organisations, working on similar issues related to agroecology and the environment to advocate for change and to improve the lives of the poorest and most marginalised. The members are Caritas Bangladesh (chair of this subgroup), Ubinig, Bangladesh Association for Sustainable Development, Bangladesh Environmental Lawyers Association and Bangladesh Krishok Federation. The other two subgroups will work on (i) Seed and Seed Sovereignty; and (ii) land & indigenous rights, farmers rights (women’s rights), biodiversity preservation.
The Promotion of Agroecology Principles Group has agreed four joint actions which include capacity building training on agroecology practices including a cross learning visit; mapping and documentation of best practices (including the publication of factsheets, policy documents, leaflets and posters; the development of a webpage for the Platform; and the holding of a learning dissemination workshop. Caritas Bangladesh will lead on the joint actions. Four group members will also conduct individual pieces of research on themes of particular interest to them: improving soil health and biodiversity in a saline environment (Caritas Bangladesh); on-farm research on agroecology/biodiversity (Ubinig); permaculture research and training (BASD); and action research on land & indigenous rights, women's rights and biodiversity preservation (BKF).
